purpose: Historical challenger research. Preserve the existing prospective freeze.
calibration: November 11 decision and setup cohort, full 24h outcome tail, same nonnegative calibration slope.
evaluation: November 13 and November 15 separate flat-start days plus valuation tails
lambda: 500 / actual priced 218-day count per side; alpha = lambda * sum of fitting weights.
relative: Uniform 357-day content. Center features and target per decision time and side; equal weight per complete multi-asset time group. Use content357 for the absolute gate.
comparison: Full portfolios plus fixed feasible state from alphabetical constant, both execution scenarios, paired marked days and changed trades.
news_subset: Rerun all matched arms on decisions with an active direct asset mention in previous four hours.
news: English archived headline/description, explicit asset links, fixed lexical event/status tags, 4-hour windows, 30-minute freshness, and three interactions with price, volume and BTC-relative return. Simulated 15-minute processing delay.
promotion: Require positive incremental after-cost net over simple controls on untouched periods with comparable exposure and agreed risk limits under both execution assumptions.
